canonical_ab_oos_163mo.note: paired NW-t lag3 of (config active - reference active) on identical months. reference = static AND factor-momentum.
canonical_ab_oos_163mo.conclusion: GBM (nonlinear multi-logic) is the least-bad forecast: beats static (paired 1.85) with least-negative oos_ret, but every seed is DOMINATED by trivial momentum (paired_vs_mom<0) + adds turnover (13.4 vs 7.3). EN combined/per-logic all far worse (regularized combos underperform static-to-momentum gap). Order robust on dual-basis EW-uni too.

dsr_sweep.verdict: FAIL (<0.5). Combo-search does not survive multiple-testing hurdle — consistent with oos_retention FAIL.

ax001_v2.verdict: GBM modestly improves crisis active (+0.19%/mo over momentum by conditioning on credit/dispersion stress) but underperforms in normal months — net dominated by momentum. Does not change graduation verdict.
